book.title: Nein Pohl Kisinlikou ong Mehn ROM

content: Mehla Sang Dihp, oh Mour Rehn Krais
Eri, dahme kitail pahn nda? Dene kitail en mihmihte nan dihp pwe kalahngan en Koht en laudla?
Soh kowahlap! Kitail mehlasangehr dihp; eri ia duwen atail kak mihmihte nan dihp?
Pwe mehlel kumwail eseier met: ni atail papidaisla oh miniminiong Krais Sises, kitail pil papidaisla oh miniminong ni eh pwoula.

Eri, pwehki atail papidaislahr, kitail iangehr pwoula oh pil iangehr seridi; pwe nin duwen Krais eh iasadasangehr mehla ni roson lingaling en Seme, ih pil duwen kitail, atail pahn pil momourki mour kapw ehu.
Pwe ma kitail miniminiong Krais ni atail iang sapwellime pwoula, eri, kitail pahn pil miniminiong ni atail pil iang sapwellime iasada.
Oh kitail pil eseier met: atail mour mering en mahs iangehr Krais pwoula ni sapwellime lohpwu, pwe manaman en dihp rehtail en iang mwomwla, pwe kitail en dehr kin liduwih dihp.
Pwe ni emen eh pahn mehla, e kin maiaudahsang pahn manaman en dihp.
Pwe ma kitail iangehr Krais pwoula, kitail pwoson me kitail pil pahn iang ieias.
Pwe kitail ese me Krais iasadasangehr mehla, oh e sohte pahn pwurehng pwoula—eri, e solahr ketiket pahn manaman en mehla.
Ni eh ketin pwoula, e ketin powedier manaman en dihp, me e ketin wiadahr pahn mehpak oh sohte mwahn pahn anahne pwurehng wia; oh mouro me e ketin ieiaski met, iei mour rehn Koht.
Eri, ih pil duwen kumwail, kumwail en kin wiahkin kumwail aramas mehla kei me mehsangehr dihp, ahpw aramas momour kei me kin miniminiong Koht rehn Krais Sises.
Eri, dihp uhdahn solahr pahn kaunda paliwaramwail kan, oh kahrehiong kumwail en kapwaiada inengen pein nsenamwail.

Kumwail dehpa pil mweidohng kisehn paliwaramwail en wiahda dihp, de kapwaiada ineng suwed. A kumwail mweidohng Koht pein kumwail, duwehte aramas me iasada sang mehla ong mour, oh pil mweidohng Koht paliwaramwail pwon pwe en wiahla tehtehn wiewia pwung.
Dihp uhdahn solahr pahn kaunkumwailda, pwe kumwail sohte kin momour pahn kosonned, pwe pahn kalahngan en Koht.
Lidun me Pwung
Eri, dah? Kitail pahn wiahda dihp pwehki atail solahr mi pahn kosonned, ahpw pahn kalahngan en Koht? Soh kowahlap!

Pwe mehlel kumwail eseier met: ni amwail mweidohng pein kumwail pwe en wiahla lidun emen oh peikiong, eri, mehlel kumwail me lidun me kumwail kin peikiong—ma ong dihp, me imwilah mehla, de ong peik, me imwilah pwung rehn Koht.
Ahpw kalahngan en Koht! Pwe mahso kumwail me lidun dihp, ahpw met kumwail kin peikiong mehlel en padahk me kumwail aleier nan mohngiongimwail kan.
Kumwail kasaledeksangehr dihp oh wialahr lidun pwung.

I doadoahngki lepin lokaia me mengei pwehki luwet en pein nsenamwail. Pwe mahso kumwail mweidohng pein kumwail en wiahla lidun samin oh suwed, oh kapwaiada ineng suwed kan. Eri met, kumwail uhdahn pahn mweidohng pein kumwail pwe kumwail en wiahla lidun pwung oh sarawihkihla.
Ni ahnsou me kumwail wia lidun dihp, iei ahnsou me kumwail saledeksang pwung.
Eri, soangen mwahu da me kumwail alehsangehr amwail wiahda mehkan me kumwail kin namenengki ahnsou wet? Imwilahn soahng pwukat mehla!
A ahnsou wet kumwail kasaledeksangehr dihp oh wialahr lidun Koht; eri, imwilahn met kumwail kasarawihongehr Koht amwail mour unsek, oh ni imwilahn mehkoaros kumwail pahn ahneki mour soutuk.
Pwe pweinen dihp, iei mehla; ahpw sapwellimen Koht kisakis sapan, iei mour soutuk rehn Krais Sises atail Kaun.
